name: Brass Collar
summary: At the Brackwell pumpkin patch, Princess wears a brass collar that Ma Stonefield wants as proof the sow is gone.

sections.title: A Trophy of Farmyard Rivalry
sections.body: Princess is a huge, prize-winning sow owned by the Brackwell family. She roams their pumpkin patch east of the Maclure homestead, and her appetite leads her into the Stonefield Farm’s crops. After losing valuable vegetables to the sow, Ma Stonefield seeks someone willing to slay her. Princess wears a brass band around her neck, and the collar proves she will not raid the Stonefield fields again.

faq.q: Where does the Brass Collar come from?
faq.answer: Princess wears the collar at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest, past the Maclure farm.

faq.q: Why does Ma Stonefield want the collar?
faq.answer: Princess eats Ma Stonefield’s prize vegetables. The collar proves to Ma Stonefield that the sow has been put down before ruining more of her harvest.
Princess belongs to the Brackwell family and roams their pumpkin patch with her smaller boar companions.

faq.q: Can anyone other than Princess drop this item?
faq.answer: Only Princess can yield the collar. It is fashioned to fit the Brackwells’ enormous prized sow.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer helping Elwynn’s rural folk, taking Princess’s collar helps settle a feud between neighboring farms.
